title: chassalia corallioides
intro: Chassalia corallioides, commonly known as Coralberry or Coral Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Chassalia corallioides include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit cytotoxic activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential health benefits.
